proof_body:
by
  intro f c R hR hf h0
  have h := AnalyticOnNhd.circleAverage_log_norm (c := c) (R := R) hR.ne' (by rwa [abs_of_pos hR]) h0
  rw [abs_of_pos hR] at h
  rw [h]
  have hnn : 0 ≤ ∑ᶠ u, (MeromorphicOn.divisor f (Metric.closedBall c R) u : ℝ) * Real.log (R * ‖c - u‖⁻¹) := by
    apply finsum_nonneg
    intro u
    by_cases hu : u ∈ Metric.closedBall c R
    · have hd : 0 ≤ MeromorphicOn.divisor f (Metric.closedBall c R) u := MeromorphicOn.AnalyticOnNhd.divisor_nonneg hf u
      apply mul_nonneg (by exact_mod_cast hd)
      by_cases hcu : c = u
      · simp [hcu]
      · have hpos : 0 < ‖c - u‖ := norm_pos_iff.mpr (sub_ne_zero.mpr hcu)
        apply Real.log_nonneg
        have hle : ‖c - u‖ ≤ R := by
          have := mem_closedBall_iff_norm.mp hu
          rwa [norm_sub_rev] at this
        rw [← div_eq_mul_inv]
        exact (one_le_div hpos).mpr hle
    · have : MeromorphicOn.divisor f (Metric.closedBall c R) u = 0 := Function.locallyFinsuppWithin.apply_eq_zero_of_notMem _ hu
      simp [this]
  linarith
target_source: ∀ (f : ℂ → ℂ) (c : ℂ) (R : ℝ), 0 < R → AnalyticOnNhd ℂ f (Metric.closedBall c R) → f c ≠ 0 → Real.log ‖f c‖ ≤ Real.circleAverage (fun z => Real.log ‖f z‖) c R
